name: PotentialWarp
author: PotentialBreaks
summary: Tempo-locked mangler in the spirit of Gross Beat: 16 one-tap patterns of half speed, tape stops, stutters and rolls, reverses, spinbacks and gates, locked to your beat. Edit any pattern step by step, roll a new one with the dice (mild to wild), or chain up to 8 patterns so it changes over a phrase.
